limitations: This batch is an enrichment pass, not exhaustive historical completeness certification.
No generation identities/dates or drawingStage changed. No drawings generated.
Unknown source dates stay absent; observedAt is access date only. Archived stock offers do not prove continued production.
Many newer Czech price lists specify nominal litres but no verified cubic capacity/cylinder count. Those version fields remain null.
No inferred PHEV system power from VW Czech price-list combustion-power columns.
Older Mégane generations and Ceed body-specific variants remain substantial gaps; see generation audit.
Power aggregation of pre-existing technical versions retains their original sources; those facts were not all independently re-researched.
